title: Flesh Ward

[[Image:FleshWard.png|right|160px]]
'''Flesh Ward''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game, but a corrected copy was included in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -2

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Any Phase''': Cast and exhaust to ignore all [[Stamina]] loss being dealt to you from one source.  Discard this spell if the [[Ancient One]] awakens.

===Correction===
The original card did not specify "Discard this spell if the Ancient One awakens." Also, the Sanity cost was zero.
